project_type: Python FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Workers edge + React 18 frontend (monorepo)
build_system: pip-compile for backend, pnpm + vite for frontend/edge, wrangler for edge
test_framework: pytest with httpx AsyncClient for backend (163 tests), vitest for edge/frontend
build_command: N/A (no compiled build step for backend; frontend: pnpm build)
test_command: python -m pytest (backend, cwd: apps/backend), pnpm test (edge, cwd: apps/edge), pnpm test (frontend, cwd: apps/frontend)
verification_instructions: Run backend tests: python -m pytest from apps/backend/. Run edge tests: pnpm test from apps/edge/. Run frontend tests: pnpm test from apps/frontend/. All 163+ backend tests must pass.
setup_instructions: Python 3.11.15 via pyenv already installed. Node 22 + pnpm@10.26.1 available. pip install -r requirements.txt for backend deps.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Docker available. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv. Node.js 22 via nvm.
contribution_requirements: All 837 existing tests must pass. AI routing: Vertex AI for English, Sarvam AI for Assamese. DO NOT use Cloudflare Worker AI.
key_patterns: Backend uses singleton pattern for AI/search clients. FastAPI dependency injection for auth. Beanie ODM for MongoDB. Upstash Redis for caching/rate-limiting. Config via pydantic-settings. Tests mock DB/Redis with AsyncMock patches.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/backend (FastAPI Python), apps/edge (Cloudflare Workers), apps/frontend (React 18 + Vite). Backend has app/ with api/v1/, services/ai/, services/search/, core/, models/, db/. Tests in apps/backend/tests/. Edge tests in apps/edge/tests/.
